SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(mn.Complete_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completeNum, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(mn.Complete_Records_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completeRecordsNum, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(mn.P_Remove_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pRemoveNum, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(mn.Account_Submit_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accountSubmit, SUM( CASE WHEN YEAR(mn.Complete_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN YEAR(mn.Complete_Records_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN YEAR(mn.P_Remove_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN YEAR(mn.Account_Submit_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS nodeNum, COUNT(mn.Plan_Id) AS projectNum FROM (SELECT * FROM gantt_milestone_statistics mn where mn.Complete_Time_Finish = (SELECT MAX(mn2.Complete_Time_Finish) FROM gantt_milestone_statistics mn2 where mn2.p_id = mn.p_id) ) mn ${authSql}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mn.Complete_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completeNum, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mn.Complete_Records_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completeRecordsNum, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mn.P_Remove_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pRemoveNum, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mn.Account_Submit_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accountSubmit, SUM( CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mn.Complete_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mn.Complete_Records_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mn.P_Remove_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mn.Account_Submit_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS nodeNum, COUNT(mn.Plan_Id) AS projectNum FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mn.p_id ORDER BY mn.Complete_Time_Finish DESC) AS rn FROM gantt_milestone_statistics mn) t WHERE t.rn = 1) mn ${authSql}

SELECT sd.D_Name AS competentDepartmentName, mn.P_Name AS projectName, mn.Complete_Time_Schedule AS planDate, mn.Complete_Time_Finish AS actualDate FROM (SELECT * FROM gantt_milestone_statistics mn where mn.Complete_Time_Finish = (SELECT MAX(mn2.Complete_Time_Finish) FROM gantt_milestone_statistics mn2 where mn2.p_id = mn.p_id) ) mn left join SYS_Department sd on sd.D_ID = mn.P_Competent_Department ${authSql} AND YEAR(mn.Complete_Time_Schedule) = #{request.year} AND MONTH(mn.Complete_Time_Schedule) BETWEEN 1 AND #{request.month} AND (mn.Complete_Time_Status = '05' OR mn.Complete_Time_Status = '03')
